name: deploy
description: CodeDeploy is a deployment service that automates application deployments to Amazon EC2 instances, on-premises instances running in your own facility, serverless Lambda functions, or applications in an Amazon ECS service.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-on-premises-instances
subcommands.description: Adds tags to on-premises instances.

subcommands.name: batch-get-application-revisions
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more application revisions.

subcommands.name: batch-get-applications
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more applications.

subcommands.name: batch-get-deployment-groups
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more deployment groups.

subcommands.name: batch-get-deployment-instances
subcommands.description: This method works, but is deprecated.

subcommands.name: batch-get-deployment-targets
subcommands.description: Returns an array of one or more targets associated with a deployment.

subcommands.name: batch-get-deployments
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more deployments.

subcommands.name: batch-get-on-premises-instances
subcommands.description: Gets information about one or more on-premises instances.

subcommands.name: continue-deployment
subcommands.description: For a blue/green deployment, starts the process of rerouting traffic from instances in the original environment to instances in the replacement environment without waiting for a specified wait time to elapse.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an application.

subcommands.name: create-deployment
subcommands.description: Deploys an application revision through the specified deployment group.

subcommands.name: create-deployment-config
subcommands.description: Creates a deployment configuration.

subcommands.name: create-deployment-group
subcommands.description: Creates a deployment group to which application revisions are deployed.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes an application.

subcommands.name: delete-deployment-config
subcommands.description: Deletes a deployment configuration.

subcommands.name: delete-deployment-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a deployment group.

subcommands.name: delete-git-hub-account-token
subcommands.description: Deletes a GitHub account connection.

subcommands.name: delete-resources-by-external-id
subcommands.description: Deletes resources linked to an external ID.

subcommands.name: deregister
subcommands.description: Removes any tags from the on-premises instance; deregisters the on-premises instance from AWS CodeDeploy; and, unless requested otherwise, deletes the IAM user for the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: deregister-on-premises-instance
subcommands.description: Deregisters an on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Gets information about an application.

subcommands.name: get-application-revision
subcommands.description: Gets information about an application revision.

subcommands.name: get-deployment
subcommands.description: Gets information about a deployment.

subcommands.name: get-deployment-config
subcommands.description: Gets information about a deployment configuration.

subcommands.name: get-deployment-group
subcommands.description: Gets information about a deployment group.

subcommands.name: get-deployment-instance
subcommands.description: Gets information about an instance as part of a deployment.

subcommands.name: get-deployment-target
subcommands.description: Returns information about a deployment target.

subcommands.name: get-on-premises-instance
subcommands.description: Gets information about an on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: install
subcommands.description: Configures and installs the AWS CodeDeploy Agent on the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: list-application-revisions
subcommands.description: Lists information about revisions for an application.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists the applications registered with the user or Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-deployment-configs
subcommands.description: Lists the deployment configurations with the user or Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-deployment-groups
subcommands.description: Lists the deployment groups for an application registered with the Amazon Web Services user or Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-deployment-instances
subcommands.description: The newer BatchGetDeploymentTargets should be used instead because it works with all compute types.

subcommands.name: list-deployment-targets
subcommands.description: Returns an array of target IDs that are associated a deployment.

subcommands.name: list-deployments
subcommands.description: Lists the deployments in a deployment group for an application registered with the user or Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-git-hub-account-token-names
subcommands.description: Lists the names of stored connections to GitHub accounts.

subcommands.name: list-on-premises-instances
subcommands.description: Gets a list of names for one or more on-premises instances.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for the resource identified by a specified Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: push
subcommands.description: Bundles and uploads to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) an application revision, which is a zip archive file that contains deployable content and an accompanying Application Specification file (AppSpec file).

subcommands.name: put-lifecycle-event-hook-execution-status
subcommands.description: Sets the result of a Lambda validation function.

subcommands.name: register
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM user for the on-premises instance, if not provided, and saves the user's credentials to an on-premises instance configuration file; registers the on-premises instance with AWS CodeDeploy; and optionally adds tags to the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: register-application-revision
subcommands.description: Registers with CodeDeploy a revision for the specified application.

subcommands.name: register-on-premises-instance
subcommands.description: Registers an on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-on-premises-instances
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from one or more on-premises instances.

subcommands.name: skip-wait-time-for-instance-termination
subcommands.description: In a blue/green deployment, overrides any specified wait time and starts terminating instances immediately after the traffic routing is complete.

subcommands.name: stop-deployment
subcommands.description: Attempts to stop an ongoing deployment.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates the list of tags in the input Tags parameter with the resource identified by the ResourceArn input parameter.

subcommands.name: uninstall
subcommands.description: Uninstalls the AWS CodeDeploy Agent from the on-premises instance.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates a resource from a list of tags.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Changes the name of an application.

subcommands.name: update-deployment-group
subcommands.description: Changes information about a deployment group.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: deployment-successful
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query deploymentInfo.status returns Succeeded when polling with ``get-deployment``.
